description: Parametric simulated learner population parameter ranges (Roadmap Sec. 9).

beta.name: forgetting_rate
beta.description: Per-step mastery decay when a concept is unpracticed.

gamma.name: difficulty_sensitivity
gamma.description: Sensitivity to mismatch between question difficulty and current mastery.

h.name: hint_dependence
h.description: How much hints boost immediate correctness vs. durable mastery gain.

tau.name: transfer_ability
tau.description: Fraction of prerequisite mastery gain that propagates to dependent concepts.

sigma.name: response_noise
sigma.description: Stochastic noise added to correctness probability.
